metadata.name: Demo Claims Volume Extract
metadata.description: Sample workflow for claims historical volume extraction and downstream enrichment. Reads Excel inputs, creates quarterly and team summaries, enriches claim detail with policy, payment and diary data, and produces product type, state, and aging/litigation risk exports.

MetaInfo.Name: Demo Claims Volume Extract

configuration.raw_xml: <Configuration><FormulaFields>Litigation Flag=if isnull([Litigation Flag]) then 'N' else [Litigation Flag] endif;Reopened Flag=if isnull([Reopened Flag]) then 'N' else [Reopened Flag] endif;Days Since Last Activity=if isnull([Last Activity Date]) then Null() else DateTimeDiff(DateTimeToday(),[Last Activity Date],'days') endif</FormulaFields></Configuration>

tools.annotation: Normalizes litigation/reopened flags and calculates days since activity.

configuration.raw_xml: <Configuration><FormulaFields>Aging Bucket=if isnull([Days Since Last Activity]) then 'No Diary Activity' elseif [Days Since Last Activity] > 90 then '90+ Days' elseif [Days Since Last Activity] > 30 then '31-90 Days' else '0-30 Days' endif</FormulaFields></Configuration>

tools.annotation: Assigns an aging bucket based on days since last activity.

configuration.raw_xml: <Configuration><SummarizeFields>Quarter End Date:GroupBy;Product Type:GroupBy;Claim Number:CountDistinct:Claim Count;Total Paid:Sum:Total Paid Amount</SummarizeFields></Configuration>

tools.annotation: Summarizes claims by product type and quarter.

configuration.raw_xml: <Configuration><SummarizeFields>Quarter End Date:GroupBy;State:GroupBy;Claim Number:CountDistinct:Claim Count;Total Paid:Sum:Total Paid</SummarizeFields></Configuration>
